services.name: Kayak & Paddle Boards
services.desc: Embark on an picturesque San Antonio adventure with our kayak and paddle board rentals. Whether you're a seasoned paddler or a first-time explorer, our rentals offer an exciting way to experience the beauty of the San Antonio River Walk. Now available on select dates and times. Begin your journey at the Tobin Performing Arts Center and paddle into a 2.5‑mile kayaking adventure along the world‑famous San Antonio River Walk. As the city wakes up, you’ll glide past iconic architecture, lush riverbanks, and historic landmarks-experiencing San Antonio from a peaceful, unforgettable perspective.
